title: Vault Sync — payload
description: Consumer requests an incremental delta of vault changes since a given seq baseline. The maintainer returns an ordered list of upsert/delete/acl/policy events, followed by a new seq baseline the consumer SHOULD persist for the next sync. Pairs with sync/event/0.1 server-push notifications: a live consumer subscribes to push events; on reconnect after offline, it calls vault/sync to catch up.

contextId.description: Optional — narrow the delta to a single context. Omit for all contexts the consumer has VaultRead on.

sinceSeq.description: The seq value the consumer last received. Omit on first sync (= full snapshot). When supplied, the maintainer returns events with seq > sinceSeq.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of events to include in this response. Maintainer-defined default and ceiling.

events.description: Ordered events; consumer applies in order. Each event carries its own `seq` (strictly monotonic, no gaps within a context). Shape is the same as sync/event/0.1's push form.

newSinceSeq.description: The seq value the consumer should persist for its next vault/sync call. Equal to the highest event seq in this response, or the consumer's prior `sinceSeq` if the response was empty.

truncated.description: true if more events exist beyond this page. Consumer SHOULD immediately call vault/sync again with `sinceSeq = newSinceSeq`.
